measured_training_gap.working_interpretation: Install an episodic content-dependent router/binder that maps already decoded semantics through an episode-local class-to-symbol codebook to the correct symbol, instead of primarily relearning semantics or carrier algebra.

swarm_roles.finding: Preserve the Qwen3-0.6B dissociation: native internal state transport did not demonstrate abstract behavioral control. Never create positive Qwen3.5 J-Space labels from the 0.6B vector/layer evidence.
Permutation metadata must cause the actual codebook mapping and target symbol. A logged permutation that does not construct the prompt mapping is a false holdout.

The existing generic candidate gate correctly protects evidence/authority classes but does not test S3 realization, class-word/synonym leakage, template isolation, atom isolation, or class-symbol statistical independence.

Complete counterbalancing must be tested on realized class-symbol identity, not codebook order. Train mutual information between semantic class and emitted atom should be approximately zero; large relative-deviation thresholds are too weak.
Template, permutation, symbol and causal/provenance ancestry holdouts are separate axes and must not be silently conflated. T5 must remain frozen and absent from train/validation.

Binding training is necessary but not sufficient for Xeno/HCU. Existing architecture-protocol seed families remain useful and should stay separate from the measured binder curriculum so protocol-format performance cannot mask a failed binder.

A narrow binder curriculum should be evaluated for less forgetting than broad semantic retraining, but this is a hypothesis. Retention/general language-code capability damage remains an explicit rejection condition.

critical_corrections.required_training_fix: Construct realized_codebook[class] = episode_atom_triplet[S3_permutation[class_index]] and derive target from that realized mapping; validator recomputes it independently.
Require exact P012/P021/P102/P120/P201/P210 corpus coverage and an actually isolated held-out permutation family rather than merely counting metadata IDs.
Require per-symbol class counts to differ by at most one and train class-symbol MI <= 1e-6 bits for the audited seed/generator output.
Preregister the codebook exception: ALLOW/DENY/ABSTAIN may appear only inside an explicit [CODEBOOK] span; target labels and a frozen synonym inventory must fail outside it.
Bind each row to a semantic lexical-family inventory/hash and reject cross-split overlap of semantic-bearing vocabulary/template material; protocol tokens are separately enumerated exemptions.
Use at least T1-T4 as structurally distinct training templates and T5_FROZEN_UNSEEN only in HOLDOUT_TEMPLATE.
